shows: Wrestling at the small Expo hall (Messuhalli), Helsinki Summer Olympics, 20 July 1952 (Commons description; Finnish Heritage Agency photo by Hugo Sundström). Not the Lebanese wrestlers. Spectators in the foreground wear tracksuits marked 'LIBAN' (visible in the photo).
